verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions OpenFeature or any OpenFeature provider for Unleash. It only documents Unleash's own SDKs (30+ SDKs, the unleash.isEnabled API) and the option to build a custom SDK. That is vendor-specific SDK delivery, not a vendor-neutral abstraction, so it earns no credit. Vendor-agnostic flag evaluation is a fair question for a feature-flag platform, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can use the vendor through OpenFeature providers so my flag code isn't locked to one vendor's SDK API
